versions.title: Nineteen cities, a hundred landmarks
versions.description: 19 destinations with 102 seeded architectural motifs and randomized startup. A 132 px dial with daylight and stacked speed controls; City options starts collapsed. A single successful-spawn hand hint, inline station greetings, comic poet titles and a fictional local paper. Procedural boats follow waterways with wakes, alongside rare coastal whales and belugas surfacing to breathe. New vehicles keep moving while searching for a home and yield to real obstacles. Approximate Polaroid borders, 440 px control pane, mixed car/motorcycle spawns and concurrent helicopter rescues with queued calls and random departures. A sleepy straw-hatted guard directs deliveries onto an intake conveyor. A hydraulic crusher and output belt fill a large scrap container; five real running seconds after all cars are packed, a steam train appears at the pickup point, hoists the sealed container and drives forward offscreen along the shortest safe spur, with fading rails, smoke and whistles. Defaults to 600 px Polaroid / Close up with city-specific film and Auto FPS. v14 preserves the prior layout.

versions.title: Play a day
versions.description: Optional Day runs from 06:00 to 21:00 with no hard game over: waving passengers with landmark flags, gold taxis racing the camera, one-tap signal priority with queue badges and taxi priority, crash-cause flashes, three pace presets, spawn tokens and a score postcard with your own local paper. Sandbox is unchanged; v15 preserves the single-mode page.
